snippet.title: Color Slayer - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Push your reflexes and slash your way forward in this fast-paced, color-based arcade game.

Move fast to avoid obstacles, and use your colored swords to cut down enemies. Act fast to build your combo, gain points, climb the leaderboards and unlock additional outfits.

Developed by The Domaginarium
Also released for PlayStation Vita and PC
